name: ratw-desktop
description: Run Against the World: the desktop client's shell (Tauri 2), docs 76 and 77. The page is Client/.

scripts.setup: npm ci && npm --prefix ../Client ci && npm --prefix ../Editor ci
scripts.app: npm --prefix ../Editor run build && npm --prefix ../Client run build && cargo run --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --
scripts.test:app: npm --prefix ../Editor run build && npm --prefix ../Client run build && cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --features e2e && node --test tests/app.test.mjs
scripts.test:editor: npm --prefix ../Editor run build && npm --prefix ../Client run build && cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --features e2e && node --test tests/editor.test.mjs
